instruction.name: vsrlrni.h.w
instruction.description: Rounding logical right shift narrowing w to h by an immediate.

latencies.notes: vj -> vd; consecutive unrolled copies form a chain. Raw measurement was 4.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vsrlrni.h.w $vr0, $vr8, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr1, $vr9, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr2, $vr10, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr3, $vr11, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr4, $vr12, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr5, $vr13, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr6, $vr14, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr7, $vr15, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; vreplgr2vr.d $vr0, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr1, $r4; vreplgr2vr.d $vr2, $r4' --asm 'vsrlrni.h.w $vr0, $vr8, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr1, $vr9, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr2, $vr10, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr3, $vr11, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr4, $vr12, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr5, $vr13, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr6, $vr14, 1; vsrlrni.h.w $vr7, $vr15, 1'

notes: Latency values are reported as whole cycles; earlier two-decimal values and +/-0.1 bands were rounding artifacts of the measurement pipeline.
